name: huasheng
description: Make videos with Huasheng from your assistant: write a script, approve the storyboard, swap footage on a clip, and export or publish. Requires the hs CLI (curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superlcr/huasheng-cli/main/install.sh | sh) and a one-time browser sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit Huasheng videos with interactive cards
interface.longDescription: Turn a script into a video, inspect the timeline, edit narration, swap footage, and export from Codex Desktop.
defaultPrompt: Create a Huasheng video from my script.
